## Summary

Fixes Jhon-Crow/audio-recorder-with-visualization#107.

- Allows selecting multiple audio files in the Audio to Video flow.
- Converts selected files sequentially into separate videos using the existing converter settings for each file.
- Names rendered videos from the source audio filename and actual output format.
- Adds a Save All button above the recordings list.
- Saves all rendered videos through one Electron folder selection when available, or sequential browser downloads otherwise.
- Merges the latest upstream `main` changes to resolve PR conflicts.
- Adds issue research and implementation analysis under `docs/case-studies/issue-107`.

## How to Reproduce

1. Open the example app.
2. Go to Audio to Video.
3. Select more than one audio file.
4. Click Convert to Video.
5. Confirm each selected audio file produces a separate rendered video.
6. Click Save All.
7. In Electron, choose the destination folder once and confirm all rendered videos are written there.

## Verification

- `npm test -- --runInBand`
- `npm run build`
- `npx cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/batch-visualization.cy.js --config baseUrl=http://127.0.0.1:8081`

## Notes

Browser Save All still triggers one download per generated video because browsers do not allow silent arbitrary-folder writes. Electron now uses one directory picker for the batch and shows the first saved item in that folder after writing all videos.
